{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dool Arena''' was a [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] wedge in the [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|Broken Tusk]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]]. It was the site of a title match between [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxers]] [[Lobar Aybock]] and [[Tull Raine]] between [[5 ABY/Legends|5]] and [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].
